description: Mechanical transcriptions of the conformance spec's worked examples. The spec's own sentence is the assertion: an implementation conforms when it reproduces each example's output exactly in element structure, attributes and their order, and text content, with only whitespace between block-level elements waived (conformance spec preamble + section 3; comparator contract in docs/testing-strategy.md section 2). Ten of the thirteen FIX rows live here as checked-in trees; FIX-06, FIX-10, and FIX-14 are realized as the landmines misaddressed-fill, slot-in-template, and layout-declares-layout. Snippet-form spec examples are wrapped in minimal complete documents; the wrapped regions are transcribed verbatim from the spec.

harnessContract.run: per case: unify build -s <case>/src -o <tmp>/dist; asserted: exit code, publish state, declared diagnostics (exhaustive), and a bidirectional tree compare against expected/ using the single harness comparator (tests/conformance/compare.mjs)
harnessContract.assetStubs: cases whose spec example references an asset (/assets/style.css, /favicon.ico, deep/page.css) include stub files so the post-build reference check passes. The stubs are not part of the spec's claim; the composed pages are.

ruleNotes.HED-05: kept-when-page-declares-none branch; the page-icon-replaces-layout branch is kitchen-sink contact.html
